The fruit shop looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The package arrived this morning.

Little by little, things began to change. David keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The farmer leaned his pitchfork against the barn wall.

At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. The experience taught David more than any book could. David will take part in a volleyball match in March. In fact, grandma knitted me a warm jumper.
David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There are always more possibilities than we expect. David's dream job is to be a cook.
